title: Advanced Authorization
description: Implement advanced authorization patterns including role-based, claims-based, policy-based, and resource-based authorization.
longDescription: This module covers advanced authorization techniques in ASP.NET Core and React applications. You will learn role-based authorization, claims-based authorization, policy-based authorization with requirements, resource-based authorization, and custom authorization handlers for complex business rules.
whatYouLearn: Implement role-based authorization with ASP.NET Core Identity
Use claims-based authorization for fine-grained access control
Create policy-based authorization with requirements and handlers
Apply resource-based authorization for entity-level security
Build custom authorization handlers for complex business rules
